findings: The active ui/App.jsx and ui/pages.jsx surface contains hard-coded Chinese system copy.
Several legacy React pages contain hard-coded English or Chinese copy; there is no shared UI translation catalog.
User and course teaching-language preferences exist, but they are content preferences and are not a UI-locale switch.
No current control beside the theme control changes only system UI language while preserving Pair, run, draft, answer and course-language state.
i18n.required_boundary: A UI locale may translate system chrome only. It must not translate user input, source material, teaching output, questions, answers, explanations or historical records, and switching must perform zero LLM calls.

student_visible_findings.behavior: renders config.model in the model-label element
contains provider/model-facing diagnostic copy; production auth does not use this branch, but the system-copy policy still needs an explicit environment boundary

internal_audit_findings: The feedback report transmits the configured model as restricted diagnostic metadata; that is allowed if it is not rendered as student system UI.
Backend config and immutable model receipts retain provider, model, revision, protocol, region and usage identities; these records must remain accurate.
model_name_ui.required_boundary: Remove provider/model brands from system chrome, messages, statuses, errors, toasts, tooltips, accessibility labels and student exports without rewriting user-authored or source content that legitimately discusses those names.
